review_metadata.scope: Ansible role for Kaneo deployment via docker-compose with API-driven project seeding

summary: Kaneo role demonstrates solid idempotency, proper handler isolation, and comprehensive templating. FQCN coverage is strong. Issues: (1) Cross-role coupling tight via hardcoded vaultwarden-caddy-1 container name in handler; consider variable injection from vaultwarden role. (2) Tag coverage incomplete—role lacks tags on key tasks; recommend adding 'kaneo-deploy' + 'kaneo-health' + 'kaneo-projects' granularity. (3) Molecule test token generation uses dynamic syntax unsupported by current Ansible version; recommend static test token. (4) Variable scoping: kaneo_api_token required but not validated upfront.

findings: All HTTP calls use correct methods (GET for reads, POST for creation)
Health check correctly uses retries + until with 60-second timeout
Project creation correctly gates on existing_project_names via when conditional
Final verification asserts exactly 6 projects; idempotency chain robust
GET-before-POST pattern correctly implemented for project seeding
Docker-compose converges to 'already running' on unchanged template
File tasks use register + notify for handlers, avoiding duplicate restarts
Caddy snippet reload only triggers on file change (not on every run)
Loop_control pause ensures rate-limit safety between project creations
ansible.builtin modules correctly specified (file, template, uri, shell, set_fact, fail, assert)
community.docker.docker_compose_v2 properly qualified
All module references follow fully-qualified naming convention
kaneo_api_token is marked CRITICAL in defaults but not validated at role entry
No upfront check for tailscale_ip fact; will fail cryptically if missing
All kaneo_ prefixes correctly applied
Defaults for kaneo_image use :latest placeholder (acceptable per README)
issues: Consider adding a 'Validate required variables' task at role start to fail fast if kaneo_api_token or tailscale_ip missing

findings: Two handlers correctly defined: 'Restart kaneo' and 'Reload caddy for kaneo vhost'
Handler separation prevents accidental Kaneo restarts when Caddy reloads
become_user: op correctly applied in restart handler
issues: Hardcoded container name 'vaultwarden-caddy-1' in 'Reload caddy' handler creates cross-role coupling. Should accept caddy_container_name variable from vaultwarden role or be parameterized via group_vars. Current design breaks if vaultwarden role renames Caddy container.

findings: docker-compose.yml.j2: Correct syntax, kaneo_api_token properly injected via environment, volumes and networks defined
Caddyfile.snippet.j2: Proper Caddy reverse_proxy with X-Forwarded headers, gzip encoding enabled
Both templates use standard Jinja2 without advanced filters; templates are clear and maintainable
Test container runs privileged with docker-in-docker support, enabling real docker-compose testing
Verify playbook comprehensively checks health, directories, files, and idempotency
Includes debug output for health response inspection
issues: molecule.yml line 28: kaneo_api_token uses dynamic timestamp syntax 'test-token-{{ ansible_date_time.iso8601_basic_short }}' which is evaluated by molecule provisioner, not Ansible; this may fail in some molecule versions. Recommend static token 'test-token-kaneo-molecule' for stability.
molecule test missing explicit assertion on project creation count before idempotency check; verify task assumes 6 projects exist but HTTP call not captured

findings: README comprehensive: 190 lines covering overview, requirements, variables, task flow, idempotency, security, networking
Variables table clear with defaults and descriptions
Troubleshooting section addresses common failures (container startup, project creation, DNS)
Kaneo image pinning guidance documented; operator action items explicit
meta/main.yml correctly specifies tailscale and base role dependencies with tags: always
Dependency ordering ensures tailscale_ip fact available and op user created before kaneo tasks run
Galaxy tags (docker, kaneo, project-management, tailscale, caddy) appropriate at role level
No task-level tags defined within tasks/main.yml
issues: Task granularity lacking. Recommend adding tags to enable selective execution: 'kaneo-deploy' (docker-compose up), 'kaneo-health' (health wait), 'kaneo-projects' (seeding). Example: 'molecule test -s kaneo --tags kaneo-projects' would allow testing only project creation without container restart overhead.

findings: Loose coupling with tailscale role (via tailscale_ip fact injection; standard pattern)
Loose coupling with base role (via op user; standard pattern)
issues: TIGHT COUPLING to vaultwarden role: Caddy handler hardcodes 'vaultwarden-caddy-1' container name. If vaultwarden role changes Caddy container naming (e.g., via compose_project_name variable), kaneo handler silently fails. Recommend: (a) Accept caddy_container_name variable from parent playbook, (b) Query running containers dynamically with docker ps filter (less fragile), or (c) Document mandatory contract with vaultwarden role in README and add validation task.

recommendations: Add upfront variable validation task (fail if kaneo_api_token or tailscale_ip undefined)
Decouple Caddy handler from hardcoded container name via variable or dynamic lookup
Add task-level tags for granular execution control (kaneo-deploy, kaneo-health, kaneo-projects)
Fix molecule test token generation to use static string instead of dynamic Ansible syntax
Add explicit project count capture in molecule verify playbook before idempotency assertion
